findings.title: SSRF: user-supplied URL fetched directly in openai_whisper provider
findings.description: reference_audio URL fetched via self.client.get(source).send() with no SSRF guard. Aleph ships hardened SSRF engine in src/security/ssrf/.
findings.trigger: Call provider.generate with reference_audio pointing at internal host

findings.title: SSRF: openai_compat edit_image_impl fetches user-supplied reference_image URL
findings.description: edit_image_impl fetches reference_image without SSRF guard. Reachable via pub trait.
findings.suggested_fix: Route through ssrf::safe_fetch with size cap

findings.title: Inconsistent URL-path validation across providers
findings.description: google_veo validates operation_name but midjourney/openai_compat/suno accept task/clip ids verbatim into URL paths
findings.suggested_fix: Apply allow-list + length cap to all provider task_url/poll_url/get_url

findings.title: URL injection via group_id in MiniMax TTS
findings.description: append_group_id builds URL with format!("{}{sep}GroupId={gid}") where gid is user-controlled and NOT URL-encoded

findings.title: clippy::indexing_slicing false-positives (informational)
findings.description: 11 false positives — all guarded by is_empty/length checks

findings.title: unreachable! comment references non-existent function
findings.description: Cites load_audio (in openai_whisper) but local helper is load_local

findings.title: parse_generation_requests pub-exported but no production caller
GenerationProvider::edit_image trait has no production caller
findings.description: Loaded foot-gun (SSRF P1) with no consumer

findings.title: Fal provider name can collide with registry canonical-index
findings.description: canonical_index keyed by user-configured name; collisions possible
findings.suggested_fix: Key by factory-issued type or document policy
